english.title: Possess / control receiving apparatus with intent self / another to use without section 8 licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) possessed or had under your control wireless telegraphy receiving apparatus,

(A)_[intending to]_
(B)_[knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), intended to]_

use it otherwise than in accordance with a wireless telegraphy licence granted by OFCOM under section 8 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) and (4) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 105 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 makes special provisions for this offence in relation to ships and aircraft.
(ii) Section 106 of the Act applies where a person is convicted of this offence and the use continues after the conviction.
(iii) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement where this offence has been committed in UK territorial sea.
(iv) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(v) Schedule 4 of the Act provides for fixed penalty notices for this offence.
(vi) The The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011 introduced a £100 fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act from 1st October 2011. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

The amount of the fixed penalty is £100, see paragraph 2 of Schedule 4 to the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 and regulations 2 and 3 of the Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011 (in force from 1st October 2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
